system.description:
You bathe a creature in targeted bursts of deep blue and purple light to clear away maladies.

Target touched creature is cured of the Intoxicated condition, as well as any non-magical infection, such as cold, flu, or pox. Alternatively, you may disinfect an object or space of Size 1 or smaller.

If an infection is magical, you may make an opposed Counteract against the creator of the infection in order to remove it.

If the Intoxicated condition comes from a magical disease, and the disease is not removed, the condition returns after 1 day.

Each extra success increases the targets by +1.
